landing.eyebrow: Buli muwa obuweereza, mu kifo kimu
landing.manifesto: Gabla ereeta abawa obuweereza abakakasiddwa, amaduuka n'abavuzi mu Uganda yonna mu kifo kimu. Londa ekika, laba abali okumpi naawe, ggulawo okukwatagana n'ensimbi entonotono, olwo obbuukinge. Osasula bokka nga bakkirizza okusaba kwo.

phone.title: Noonya. Ggulawo. Bbuukinga.
phone.body: Okuva ku kunoonya okutuuka ku kubbuukinga okukakasiddwa nga tolese Gabla. Laba abawa obuweereza abakakasiddwa, ggulawo okukwatagana omulundi gumu ku kyuma kino, osasule oluvannyuma lw'okukkirizibwa.
phone.unlockSub: Ensimbi omulundi gumu, kijjukirwa ku kyuma kino
